channel.title: SolidCraft CAD – CAD models
channel.description: Recent content in CAD models on SolidCraft CAD

item.title: Hub75DisplayCase
item.description: One clearly parametrized assembly: five lightweight HUB75 modules, 12 mm sidewalls/bottom/roof, 9 mm attached rear, 4 mm glass and four straight-mitred wooden retainers from one GlassStrip class. The roof extends 10 mm in front and 1 mm beyond the attached rear sheet. Eight printed corner brackets, two per corner, share the hole-free CornerBracket definition. The four rear brackets stop at the sidewall rear face (Y=75), before the 9 mm backboard (Y=75..84). The R4 fillets belong to the roof and bottom boards, not the glazing strips.

item.title: Hub75DisplayCase v2
item.description: Second-generation wooden HUB75 enclosure. It keeps the 844 × 362 mm display opening and five-panel layout while adding a 70 mm clear lower compartment, a 12 mm intermediate shelf, two 12 mm dividers, full-depth side walls with hand slots, and an inset display-only rear board.

item.title: FlexBenchDog
item.description: A simple printable bench dog inferred from the Mini-MFT reference image: 20 mm above and 20 mm below the worktop, with one full-length tapered insert from Ø20.0 at the worktop to Ø20.2 at the free end. A compact Ø22 stop collar seats on the 45° chamfer of a nominal Ø20 MFT hole: its lower edge chamfers back to Ø20 while a 0.5 mm Ø22 land remains above. Two perpendicular slots create four flexible legs, with R0.5 mm relief on the four material corners around the central cross. The top face carries a recessed BrainBox cube/box wireframe with six perimeter strokes and three centre spokes; there is no screw mechanism.

item.title: Hub75Panel
item.description: Shared panel component from the existing OpenSCAD reference: a 159.70 × 319.71 × 14.50 mm envelope with four rear pockets, six rear-side Ø3 bores in Ø8.5 mounting tubes, separate rear reinforcement features, two locator pins and a grey housing material. Standalone uses the component’s own local XY/Z axes; screen assemblies rotate the exact same class into world XZ.

item.title: CornerBracket
item.description: One shared CornerBracket is reused by the standalone model and the wooden HUB75 enclosure. Its native outline includes the 0.6 mm arm-tip relief, with inner R4 fillet and broad-face chamfers kept editable. Four fixing seats use separate flat head recess, 90° transition, through-bore and 0.2 mm edge-relief features instead of one oversized countersink.

item.title: CsgCube
item.description: A constructive solid geometry demonstration: intersect a cube with a sphere, then subtract cylinders along three axes.

item.title: Plate
item.description: A feature-based plate: sketch, extrusion, four vertical fillets and a through-hole sketch.

item.title: BasicHub75Screen
item.description: Five panels on the source project’s 800 × 320 mm nominal grid. One rear-tapered, four-bay panel component is reused at X=−320, −160, 0, 160 and 320 mm. Columns 2 and 4 reverse direction around the assembled front-to-back axis for the rear data chain, and all occurrences stand upright in XZ. R5 corners, detailed rear reinforcements, PCB and connectors remain future phases.

item.title: GuideRail — Festool profile
item.description: The generic GuideRail component with its default Festool profile. The aluminium cross-section comes from the FS 1400/2 STEP reference and is calibrated to the TSO measured 184.20 × 10.50 mm envelope. Only rail length is a native CAD parameter.

item.title: GuideRail — Makita profile
item.description: A second fixed cross-section of the generic GuideRail component. The aluminium shape comes from the Makita 199141-8 STEP reference and is calibrated to the TSO measured 182.50 × 10.28 mm envelope. The standalone CAD example uses 600 mm for compact visual inspection; Makita’s referenced product length is 1500 mm.

item.title: Plastic Enclosure
item.description: Rebuilds the supplied enclosure with the normal SCPF Box sketch/extrusion, followed by native Shell, Lip, Snap Fit, Boss and Rest features.

item.title: Simple MFT
item.description: A reusable CRAFTMAKER-inspired worktop component: one 18 mm native Box, four straight 20 mm corner chamfers, 59 Ø20 dog holes on the nominal 9 × 7 / 76 mm grid with the four diagonal ring-2 positions omitted, and eight photo-measured native diagonal Slots.

item.title: Simple MFT assembly
item.description: The first Simple MFT assembly reuses the exact worktop component and the generic GuideRail component. The rail runs along the short Y/depth direction, is centred over X=0 and rests on the parametrically shared worktop top face.

item.title: Bolted Flange
item.description: A compact primitive model: Ø100 × 10 flange, Ø44 × 16 hub, Ø24 bore and six Ø9 bolt holes on a 70 mm PCD.

item.title: Vent Plate
item.description: Recreates the small SolidCraft Vent Plate example with a rounded 120 × 80 × 4 mm plate, one rectangular source cut and one native two-direction rectangular pattern.

item.title: Plastic Enclosure Pi
item.description: Reconstructs the Raspberry Pi 4 video using a rounded open-top shell, mounting bosses, connector cuts, floor vents, Pi 4 lettering and PETG material.

item.title: SamplePlate
item.description: Builds a centered plate with native Base, Holes and Bore sketches. One parameter-driven Ø8 hole cut is repeated by a native rectangular pattern, while a Ø24 boss is joined between the two cuts.

item.title: Bracket
item.description: An XZ polygon extruded along Y with an edge fillet and two native SolidCraft Hole features.
